articles.summary: In the latest report, covering 2025, greenhouse gas emissions per sold car are down 31% compared with our 2020 baseline, from 45.9 to 31.7 tCO₂e.
articles.title: No headlines, just progress: how 31% lower emissions stopped feeling like news
